channel.title: Ukiyoe Edo Life
channel.desc: For a time during the Edo period, fireworks lit up the skies practically every night in the summer. It was a chance for women to dress up and let loose ... and grab the attention of male suitors.\n\n*\"Women Watching Fireworks at Sumida River\" (1795-96) by Kitagawa Utamaro.
